title: Line sketch: Surreal Dali-inspired Landscape Clock
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A circular composition merges a dreamlike landscape with a central tower and floating symbolic objects, evoking Salvador Dali's melting clocks and bizarre juxtapositions. Scattered around the main orb are a butterfly, billiard ball, bat, and other enigmatic forms on a muted background (derived from painting #866).
